The Board's stated intent to "deprioritize American interests" conflicts directly with the foundational mandate of QuantumShield. Continuing without the safeguards you identified will likely result in the loss of our strategic advantage and potential violation of DoD regulations.

I am copying my internal contacts to ensure this discussion proceeds via the proper compliance channels rather than risking an unauthorized data export.

Regards,

Alex
NovaStar Systems AI
